steps: Apply Pythagoras' theorem: $$a^2 + b^2 = c^2 \implies b^2 = c^2 - a^2$$

steps: Use tangent ratio: $$\tan(\text{angle of depression}) = \frac{\text{Height } h}{\text{Horizontal Distance } d}$$

A yacht sails ${scope.east} km due east from an island, then ${scope.south} km due south. Calculate the direct distance $d\text{ km}$ of the yacht from the island to 3 significant figures.
steps: Since East and South directions are perpendicular ($90^\circ$), use Pythagoras' theorem: $$d^2 = \text{east}^2 + \text{south}^2$$
